Privacy.metaDescription: What data this site collects and how it is used.
Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.intro: This site uses no tracking cookies and never sells data. Here is what is collected and why.
Privacy.visitsBody: Each page view is recorded together with its language. To count unique visitors per day, your IP address and browser type are turned into a one-way random code with a key that changes every day, so you cannot be identified or followed across days. Raw IP addresses are never stored. Raw records are deleted after {days} days; only daily totals are kept.
Privacy.contactBody: Your name, email, subject, and message are stored so I can reply. Your IP address is only kept as a random code to prevent spam. Messages are kept until I delete them.
Privacy.cvBody: Only the number of downloads and the page language are recorded, with no personal data.
Privacy.servicesBody: The site runs on Vercel, the database on Neon (Singapore), and images and the CV on Cloudinary. These services are used only while they are switched on: Resend to send email, Vercel Web Analytics and Speed Insights to record visit counts and page speed without cookies (page addresses without parameters), and Sentry for server error reports without personal data. Each receives only the data it needs to do its job.
Privacy.rightsBody: You can ask for a copy or deletion of your data through the contact page.
